item.title: Overhanging trees obstructing streetlight between Boverton avenue and Boverton drive, 3rd October
item.description:
Alleyway between 32 and 34 Boverton avenue leading to boverton drive. Hedge to the right bordering 32 boverton avenue has been cut.back but the problem is with the trees at the back of 34 Boverton avenue on the left overhanging the alleyway and seriously restricting street lighting to the alleyway. At this time of year with dark nights, this makes the alleyway very dangerous, as no light shines on the footpath causing serious danger of slips and trips in the dark. Also, there is no sight of approaching pedestrians in either direction, which could cause serious distress to pedestrians.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 31, Boverton Avenue, Coopers Edge, Gloucester
Report on FixMyStreet
